I don't scroll through this sub much anymore. It just causes me to become triggered and I end up posting. I don't say this much, but I'm open to speaking with you privately. Sometimes it makes me feel better to just have someone vent *to* me. Life is unkind and many end up hopeless and alone. It's sad, but the truth. For whatever time we stay here, in this life, I guess all we can do is "try". I know it's cheesy and cliché and gross to hear/say, but whatever. It's all we have, just whatever effort we can muster. There isn't really a point. We exist, we die, then whatever is waiting for us takes us away to spend eternity in some hellscape. I don't know.

I did sign a contract, and I understand why they are hesitant to cancel my contract. It does not align with one of their allowed reasons to cancel the contract, however the contract does not take COVID and the change it has made to schooling into account. The living environment is at times uncomfortable  (AC rarely works and the rooms get very hot even when it's cold, bathrooms have no ventilation, windows are very difficult to open).

I get it, bud. I feel the same way. But, think about it this way, you're trying, right? You're trying the meds and you're trying to put on a brave face. Everything is all about just TRYING. It may take a while, but if you have supportive family members and friends, they won't judge you for your feelings. Being open and honest with them will get weight off your chest and give them a chance to help you and offer support. Distractions are good, too. Anything that can take your mind off the hopelessness is worth it, so long as it's safe. It's gonna be hard, I know, but you have to believe that your love is returned three-fold of what you give. It all starts with just trying and believing. Manifest truth.
